components.name: Navigation rail

components.html: aboutprojectsvideos3D
components.css: .ds-nav {display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;} .ds-nav a {font-size:clamp(26px,2.25vw,34px);line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted, #acada6);font-family: var(--font-plex-sans, "IBM Plex Sans"), sans-serif; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), background-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), border-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));} .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] {color:var(--accent, #c6c99f);} .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6c99f); outline-offset: 6px; } @media(max-width:700px){.ds-nav{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 28px}.ds-nav a{font-size:18px;padding-block:8px}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { [class^="ds-"] { transition: none !important; } }

components.css: .ds-project{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);gap:40px;padding:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#36392f);font-family:var(--font-plex-sans,"IBM Plex Sans"),sans-serif}.ds-title{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display,"Bodoni Moda"),Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(26px,2.3vw,36px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--foreground,#f0eee8)}.ds-copy{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#acada6);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75}.ds-project-link{color:var(--accent,#c6c99f);font-size:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--accent,#c6c99f);text-underline-offset:.15em;font-family:inherit; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), background-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), border-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));}.ds-project-link:hover{color:var(--accent,#c6c99f)}.ds-project-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6c99f); outline-offset: 6px; }@media(max-width:1200px){.ds-project{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { [class^="ds-"] { transition: none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
The artist monograph direction uses flat charcoal, ivory, stone, and pale olive. Aaron’s name, writing, and work carry the composition; a large upright serif gives the site its identity while supporting copy and controls remain direct.

Open space and restrained dividing lines organize the portfolio. The OLED checker shares the palette and typography, with more explicit boundaries for file selection and results.
keyCharacteristics: Open layouts with a quiet navigation rail.
Regular literary display type paired with practical sans-serif copy.
Pale olive for active navigation and actions.

rules.name: The Display Type Rule
rules.body: Use regular Bodoni Moda for display headings; preserve its mixed-case letterforms.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate content with space, subtle borders, and tone rather than shadows.

dos: Do keep copyright on the left and footer links on the right; stack the footer on narrow screens.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the shared serif for page and project headings and the sans-serif for supporting text.
donts: Don’t substitute Bodoni Moda SC for the regular display family.
Don’t introduce a dotted background or decorative shadows.
Don’t wrap every portfolio entry in a filled card.
